name: sandbox
description: Pay-per-session sandbox service using x402 micropayments

scripts.build: npm run build -w @x402s/shared && npm run build -w @x402s/sdk && npm run build -w @x402s/api && npm run build -w @x402s/controller && npm run build -w @x402s/cli
scripts.typecheck: npm run build -w @x402s/shared && npm run build -w @x402s/sdk && tsc -p api/tsconfig.json --noEmit && tsc -p controller/tsconfig.json --noEmit && tsc -p cli/tsconfig.json --noEmit && tsc -p tsconfig.tests.json --noEmit
scripts.test: npm run test:unit && npm run test:property
scripts.clean: rm -rf shared/dist sdk/dist api/dist controller/dist cli/dist
